question: A company uses Claude to process customer support tickets that contain personal data and generate draft responses referencing account details. Before these drafts are sent, what should the workflow include?
options: A) The company adds a footer noting that personal data may appear in the message before sending it
B) A support agent reviews each draft to confirm the personal data referenced is accurate and handled properly
C) The support team increases the model's response length so more context is included automatically
D) Send the drafts automatically since the account details came straight from the customer's own support ticket
correct_answers: B) A support agent reviews each draft to confirm the personal data referenced is accurate and handled properly
explanations: Incorrect. A disclaimer footer does not verify that the personal data in the draft is accurate or appropriately handled.
Correct. Responses referencing personal data carry privacy and accuracy risk, so a support agent should review each draft before it reaches the customer.
Incorrect. A longer response does not address the accuracy or privacy handling of the personal data referenced in the draft.
Incorrect. Data originating in the customer's ticket does not guarantee the model referenced or handled it correctly in the generated draft.
